name: The Local Plettenberg Bay
address: The Market Square Shopping Centre, Beacon Way, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Locally-roasted coffee and wholesome breakfasts in the heart of Plett's Market Square.
description_long:
Tucked into Market Square Shopping Centre, The Local Plettenberg Bay brings quality coffee culture to the heart of Plett. This neighbourhood café roasts their own beans and serves them alongside wholesome breakfasts and light meals that locals return to again and again.

The menu focuses on doing the basics exceptionally well — think proper flat whites, generous breakfast bowls, and fresh pastries that pair perfectly with their signature roasts. The relaxed atmosphere makes it equally suited for a quick morning coffee or a leisurely catch-up with friends.

Conveniently located on Beacon Way, it's become a favourite pit stop for locals running errands and visitors exploring Plettenberg Bay's shops. The casual setting and consistent quality have earned it a loyal following among coffee lovers who appreciate an honest cup without the fuss.
